questions.stem: An energy level diagram shows products at a higher energy level than reactants with ΔH = +92 kJ/mol. What type of reaction does this represent?

options.text: Endothermic, because products have more energy than reactants
Exothermic, because the ΔH value is large

questions.explanation: When products are at a higher energy level than reactants, the reaction is endothermic. The positive ΔH value (+92 kJ/mol) confirms that energy has been absorbed from the surroundings and stored in the products.

questions.stem: A student draws an energy level diagram with products above reactants and labels ΔH as negative. What error has the student made?

options.text: The products should be drawn below the reactants for a negative ΔH
The axes are the wrong way around
The diagram is correct; no error has been made
The ΔH arrow should point sideways, not vertically

questions.explanation: If ΔH is negative (exothermic), the products must be at a lower energy level than the reactants. Products above reactants would indicate a positive ΔH (endothermic). The student has a mismatch between the diagram and the sign of ΔH.
